## One-line ask

Land HANDOFF block for J42: **head is a sphere/ellipsoid (not a capsule with L≈r); real soft male neck is squat (ANSUR Neck Link r/L≈0.59) so Dola double-end inset cannot survive on neck even at correct L; their Neck→Head span is also short vs ~108 mm C7–tragion — refuse L−2r on head & neck; one neck volume + named grip anchors.**

## Q2 / Q3 / Q4 one-liners

- **Q2:** Both — anatomy is squat (r/L≈0.59 on Neck Link) so inset dies; their L is also short vs ~108 mm.
- **Q3:** Shipping systems use head sphere/short capsule; neck often thin or absent as its own soft volume (ATDs are the exception with a mechanical neck).
- **Q4:** Collar / RNC / guillotine → one neck volume + named anchors, not three volumes (levels within ~0.11 m Neck Link; mid pairs often ≤~0.03–0.05 m).

## Landed side

**Refuse double-end inset on head and neck. Head = sphere/ellipsoid (C153 prior correct). Neck = keep volume, fix span toward C7–tragion (~0.11 m), change inset policy. Grips = anchors on one tube.**
